notes.title: Patch 1.1 - Now Live
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36874158/a8eeff70e9a837d8f7c9101191294968722ad858.png


Hey Chefs!
We have Patch 1.1 now live for you to download right away. The following is the breakdown:



New stuff:

 Added carrot to the editor
 Add in-game playtime timer (new options setting)
 Add hints to the hard-to-find graveyard coin making it easier to find
 Make bomb mortar targets more clear and deterministic


Bugfixes:

 Fix player being able to get stuck in phantasm precinct
 Fix rabbits magically turning into rollbits
 Fix objects being dragged along with sliding player
